description: This file contains helper functions for OAuth client management and user login automation in Playwright tests, including functions to navigate settings, create OAuth clients, and upload logos.

methods.name: loginAsSeededAdmin
methods.description: Automates login as a seeded admin user by filling login form and waiting for response.

methods.name: goToDeveloperOAuthSettings
methods.description: Navigates to the developer OAuth settings page if not already there.

methods.name: goToAdminOAuthSettings
methods.description: Navigates to the admin OAuth settings page if not already there.

methods.name: createPendingOAuthClient
methods.description: Creates a new OAuth client with specified input data, uploads logo, and returns client ID and secret.

methods.name: openOAuthClientDetailsFromList
methods.description: Opens OAuth client details from list by client ID and verifies visibility.

methods.name: closeOAuthClientDetails
methods.description: Closes the OAuth client details view if it is open.
